analysis.summary: Bajaj Auto delivered its highest quarterly performance in Q1 FY27, with revenues crossing INR 17,244 crores and EBITDA margins reaching 20.9%. The quarter was marked by significant commodity inflation, supply chain disruptions, and a ransomware attack, which constrained product availability by 10% to 15%. To support future growth, the company is expanding its annual capacity by almost 25% to progressively reach 9 million units. Management reported a record-setting performance for Q4 and FY26, driven by growth across all business units, a richer product mix, and favorable currency realizations despite operating in a volatile environment. The company noted that demand has softened in April due to general inflation, price hikes, LPG shortages, and manpower migration, which is expected to moderate near-term industry motorcycle growth.

guidance.claim: The company aims to complete its exhaustive portfolio makeover within the next six weeks.
guidance.quote: Our aim is to accomplish this exhaustive portfolio makeover within the next 6 weeks.

guidance.claim: The company aims to introduce two new brands in the 125cc segment during the year.
guidance.quote: Further, in the year, we aim to introduce 2 new brands in the 125cc segment to cover the full spectrum of customers in this large segment as well as proposition customers from the 100cc segment to upgrade.

guidance.claim: The management estimates that motorcycle category growth will slow down to 7% to 9% in the near term.
guidance.quote: This is bound to slow down the motorcycle category from its rocking 20% growth in Q4 to we estimate 7% to 9% in the near term.

demand_outlook.claim: The domestic two-wheeler industry registrations grew by 14% year-on-year in Q1.
demand_outlook.quote: The two-wheeler industry turned in a resilient performance as registrations grew by 14% year-on-year in quarter 1, though much lower than the 25% growth of quarter 4, but under the circumstances, a very healthy performance.

demand_outlook.claim: The growth in the two-wheeler industry was driven by EV scooters and the 150cc to 400cc motorcycle segment.
demand_outlook.quote: This growth was driven by EV scooters and the 150cc to 400cc segment of motorcycles.

demand_outlook.claim: The 100cc and 125cc segments were flattish, leading to a 7% growth in the motorcycle industry.
demand_outlook.quote: The 100cc and 125cc segments were flattish, resulting in a motorcycle growth in the industry of 7%.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for Chetak electric scooters continued to outpace the company's ability to supply.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand, however, continued to remain ahead of our ability to supply.

demand_outlook.claim: The company experienced robust demand on the ICE side, particularly in exports.
demand_outlook.quote: Interestingly, demand has been robust on the ICE side too, particularly in exports.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand environment in both domestic and international key markets remains very positive.
demand_outlook.quote: Having said that, the demand environment, both in domestic and international, particularly in our key markets, is very positive, though the business environment may still be a bit volatile.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand environment softened in April due to general inflation, increased vehicle prices, LPG shortages, and manpower migration.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand environment, it has softened in April due to general inflation, increased prices of our vehicles, LPG shortages, manpower migration and the LPG shortage-led effect on the consumer sentiment.

demand_outlook.claim: The 3-wheeler electric segment has experienced very fast growth due to consumer sentiment favoring the adoption of electric vehicles.
demand_outlook.quote: In the 3-wheeler segment, actually, the ICE segment has come down, but the electric segment has seen very, very fast growth because you see LPG shortage has been there, there is a CNG issue, there is a petrol price hike imminent.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the external environment remains volatile, uncertain, and complex with emerging challenges.
demand_outlook.quote: As we look ahead to FY2027, the external environment remains volatile, uncertain and complex. Geopolitical developments, commodity inflation, supply chain disruptions and shifts in global trade dynamics are creating challenges in the operating environment, that are particularly pronounced as we start the new financial year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that long-term potential across domestic consumption and electric mobility remains significant.
demand_outlook.quote: India continues to be one of the world’s fastest growing major economies, with almost unparalleled long-term potential across both domestic consumption and electric mobility.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is expanding its capacity by nearly 25% to progressively reach 9 million units per annum from the current 7 million.
capex_expansion.quote: So, with an eye on the future, we are undertaking an expansion of capacity by almost 25% from the current 7 million units per annum across different businesses to progressively go up to 9 million units per annum.

capex_expansion.claim: The capacity expansion will primarily target EVs, high-end motorcycles, and three-wheelers.
capex_expansion.quote: The key areas to address will be EVs, both two-wheelers and three-wheelers, high-end motorcycles and three-wheelers.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has almost 90 operational joint KTM-Triumph stores to expand reach.
capex_expansion.quote: The rollout of the joint KTM-Triumph stores to expand reach while ensuring store viability is progressing steadily with now almost 90 outlets operational.

capex_expansion.claim: Capacity expansion has been undertaken with immediate and medium-term focuses to serve the growing market.
capex_expansion.quote: Capacity expansion has been undertaken, with an immediate and medium-term focus to enable us better serve the growing market.

capex_expansion.claim: Manufacturing capacity in Brazil has increased to 60,000 units per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: Sales nearly 10,000 units during the quarter, supported by expanded manufacturing capacity, which has now increased to 60,000 units per annum, successful new product introductions like the 400 NS and wider market presence with almost 70 top-class stores.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for the year was approximately INR500 crores, split equally between ICE and EV investments.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex for the year was approximately INR500 crores, split equally between ICE and EV investments.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested meaningfully in electric mobility, financing business, R&D, and acquiring control over the KTM group.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year, your Company invested meaningfully across strategic priorities — notably on growing its presence in electric mobility, scaling up its financing business through Bajaj Auto Credit, sharpening its R&D capabilities through Bajaj Auto Technology, acquiring and assuming control over the KTM group, while widening its portfolio/footprint to leverage both domestic and international growth opportunities.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins rose sequentially by 10 basis points to 20.9% despite a hyperinflationary commodity environment.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins inched up to 20.9%, an improvement of 10 basis points sequentially despite the hyperinflationary commodity environment that I'd spoken about.

margins_costs.claim: Commodity inflation across the metals complex accelerated through May, impacting the quarter by about 4.5% of revenue.
margins_costs.quote: Inflation across the metals complex accelerated meaningfully through May, taking the overall inflationary impact for the quarter to about 4.5% of revenue.

margins_costs.claim: Year-on-year margins improved by 110 basis points, driven by favorable currency movements and improved operating leverage.
margins_costs.quote: On a year-on-year basis, margins improved by 110 basis points, primarily driven by favourable currency movements and improved operating leverage, which more than offset the adverse cost versus price dynamics.

margins_costs.claim: Cost pressures have broadened to include proprietary components, electronics, electrical parts, labor, logistics, and energy.
margins_costs.quote: The cost pressures have become more broader, with proprietary components, electronics, electrical parts, labour, logistics and energy and conversion now moving up simultaneously and meaningfully.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for the quarter held steady at 20.8%.
margins_costs.quote: Margins held steady at levels of 20.8%, and this marks yet another quarter of sustained delivery above 20% threshold even as we navigate various challenges.

margins_costs.claim: The cost environment is witnessing a potential rise of about 3% to 5% driven by the metal complex during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: The cost environment is seeing a potential rise during the quarter of about 3% to 5%, driven by the metal complex.

margins_costs.claim: Material cost inflation impact is currently estimated at approximately 3.5% to 4% of revenue for the upcoming period.
margins_costs.quote: Taken together, we are currently estimating a material cost inflation impact of approximately 3.5% to 4% of revenue.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity has emerged as a key constraint to the company's growth.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacities have emerged as a key constraint to growth.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's EV two-wheeler capacity is currently limited to 50,000 units.
orders_capacity.quote: So, we are right now at 50,000 units. We are limited at that for EV two-wheelers.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales of certain models in both domestic and international markets were restricted due to capacity issues.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity issues restricted sales of some models, both in India and overseas.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity for Chetak has reached 50,000 units per month.
orders_capacity.quote: And we have now a capacity of 50,000 units per month.

orders_capacity.claim: Annual volumes crossed 5 million units, the highest ever in the company's history.
orders_capacity.quote: Your Company scaled new heights during the year, delivering its highest-ever annual volumes at over 5 million units, overtaking its previous peak set several years ago.

orders_capacity.claim: Assets Under Management of Bajaj Auto Credit grew to ₹18,835 crore as of 31 March 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Assets Under Management grew ~2X to H 18,835 crore as of 31 March 2026, Total Income stood at H 3,248 crore, up >3X and Profit After Tax at H 665 crore surged >11X, all over previous year.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated over INR 2,300 crores of free cash flow in the quarter, representing nearly 80% cash conversion of profit after tax.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated over INR2,300 crores of free cash flow during this quarter, almost double that of the same period last year, translating into a cash conversion of almost 80% of profit after tax.

capital_allocation.claim: The company ended the June quarter with surplus cash exceeding INR 21,000 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: The balance sheet continues to remain very healthy with surplus cash in excess of INR21,000 crores at the end of the June quarter, well managed and providing sufficient fuel for future growth investments, strategic opportunities and improved shareholder returns.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors approved a payout of 100% of the profits made last year, split between a final dividend of INR150 per share and a buyback under the tender route at INR12,000 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: Lastly, the Board of Directors at its meeting earlier today approved a payout of 100% of the profits that we have made last year in recognition of the 100 years milestone of the Bajaj family in India and with Bajaj Auto being the flagship company that started it all. his will be split as follows a final dividend of INR150 per share that will aggregate to INR4,192 crores and the balance of about INR5,633 crores will be towards a buyback under the tender route at a buyback price of INR12,000 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board approved a payout of 100% of the Profit after Tax for the year through a combination of dividend and share buyback.
capital_allocation.quote: In recognition of the Bajaj Group’s centenary year and Bajaj Auto’s position as the flagship Company, the Board approved a payout of 100% of the Profit after Tax for the year to shareholders, through a combination of dividend and share buyback, amounting to nearly H 10,000 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: Surplus cash and cash equivalents stood at ₹18,137 crore as on 31 March 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: Surplus cash and cash equivalent as on 31 March 2026 at J 18,137 crore, which was 6.7% more than previous year, after investing ~ J 500 crore in CAPEX, J 2,300+ crore in strategic bets (BACL and BAIH BV) and ~ J 5,900 crore to shareholders as dividend.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a final dividend of ₹150 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors have recommended a Final Dividend of J 150 per share and Share Buyback through tender offer route.

risks_headwinds.claim: The quarter was impacted by raw material inflation, supply chain and logistics disruptions, and a ransomware attack.
risks_headwinds.quote: It was a tough quarter with RM inflation, supply chain and logistics disruptions as well as a ransomware attack, which you may have read about, but it was defended comprehensively and successfully.

risks_headwinds.claim: Supply chain issues and other disruptions reduced product availability by approximately 10% to 15%.
risks_headwinds.quote: All of these above issues combined impaired availabilities by about 10% to 15%, more so in exports, high-end bikes and EVs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Fuel availability became a major challenge early in the quarter due to the curtailment of industrial LPG supplies.
risks_headwinds.quote: To start with, fuel availability became a significant challenge early in the quarter following the curtailment of industrial LPG supplies.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical developments in West Asia led to force majeure declarations by some global suppliers and disrupted maritime logistics.
risks_headwinds.quote: At the same time, geopolitical developments in West Asia led to force majeure declarations by certain global suppliers and disrupted maritime logistics, resulting in tightness across key raw materials, particularly aluminum alloys and polymers.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company experienced localized manpower shortages driven by higher living costs and election-related migration.
risks_headwinds.quote: We also experienced localized manpower availability challenges during parts of the quarter, driven by higher cost of living arising from spiralling LPG costs and workforce migration due to elections.

risks_headwinds.claim: Inflation and international logistics remain key areas that require close management.
risks_headwinds.quote: But inflation and international logistics will need to be managed closely.

risks_headwinds.claim: Supply chain difficulties regarding LPG shortages, manpower availability, and outbound logistics have impaired availability to service demand by about 10% to 15%.
risks_headwinds.quote: Supply chain difficulties in terms of the LPG shortage, manpower availability and outbound logistics to overseas markets have impaired availability to service demand by about 10% to 15%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Non-availability of rare earth magnets due to export restrictions from China created supply disruption in the first half.
risks_headwinds.quote: Non-Availability of rare earth magnets, a consequence of export restrictions from China, created supply disruption in the first half, constraining volumes even as consumer demand remained strong.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to complete its exhaustive portfolio makeover within the next six weeks.
management_commitments.quote: Our aim is to accomplish this exhaustive portfolio makeover within the next 6 weeks.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to introduce two new brands in the 125cc segment during the year.
management_commitments.quote: Further, in the year, we aim to introduce 2 new brands in the 125cc segment to cover the full spectrum of customers in this large segment as well as proposition customers from the 100cc segment to upgrade.

management_commitments.claim: The company is expanding its capacity by nearly 25% to progressively reach 9 million units per annum from the current 7 million.
management_commitments.quote: So, with an eye on the future, we are undertaking an expansion of capacity by almost 25% from the current 7 million units per annum across different businesses to progressively go up to 9 million units per annum.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to expand its Chetak store network to 1,000 stores in a couple of years.
management_commitments.quote: I can see 1,000 stores coming in a couple of years.

management_commitments.claim: The team will remain focused on gaining share in the 125cc plus segment and particularly the 150cc plus segment throughout Q1 and the rest of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Through Q1 and rest of FY27, the team will remain absolutely focused on the areas which I've highlighted earlier, gaining share in the 125cc plus segment, particularly in the 150cc plus segment riding the continued industry growth.

management_commitments.claim: New introductions in the Pulsar brand will hit the market as early as July.
management_commitments.quote: There will be hopefully, I think we will see these new introductions hitting the market as early as July in the Pulsar brand itself.

management_commitments.claim: Payouts for the buyback would essentially happen sometime in the second week of July.
management_commitments.quote: Looking at the fresh timelines, I would expect that payouts would essentially happen sometime in the second week of July likely.

management_commitments.claim: The AGM of the company is scheduled to be held on Tuesday, 21 July 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Notice is hereby given that the Nineteenth Annual General Meeting (‘AGM’) of the members of Bajaj Auto Ltd. (‘BAL’ or ‘the Company’) will be held on Tuesday, 21 July 2026 at 12:30 pm at the Registered Office of the Company at Mumbai-Pune Road, Akurdi, Pune 411035

management_commitments.claim: Rakesh Sharma was appointed as Joint Managing Director from 1 June 2026 up to 31 March 2029.
management_commitments.quote: approval of the members be and is hereby accorded for the appointment of Rakesh Sharma (DIN: 08262670) as the Joint Managing Director (‘JMD’) of the Company with effect from 1 June 2026 upto 31 March 2029

management_commitments.claim: Payment of commission to Non-executive Directors is approved for a period of five years commencing from 01 April 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Approval for payment of commission to Non-executive Directors for a period of five years commencing from 01 April 2026.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
